0.original: Marabel is beaming with pride.<hex:02100103>※This quest is available for a limited time only.

1.original: As thanks for helping her win the Little Ladies' Day walk-off, Marabel has offered to lend you her styling expertise in your efforts to outfit a model of your own. You agree to come up with a concept and report back to her near the stage.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Please note that you will be unable to complete this quest after the seasonal event has ended. For details, please check the Lodestone.

2.original: Marabel has prepared a dazzling ensemble for your chosen model─who, for their part, seems quite pleased with this change of costume. You decide to thank Marabel for her services.

3.original: Pleased with your foray into the fashion world, Marabel has agreed to provide further styling assistance for a model of your choosing. You kindly accept, promising to stop by again if time permits.

48.original: Oh, hello there, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>! Don't tell me, dahling─has your turn on the stage given you fashion fever?

49.original: Well, it just so happens that <hex:021A020203>the<hex:021A020103> Masked Rose will be holding a Fashion Check as part of the day's festivities! Of course, we'll require a model, but if you have someone in mind, do let me know!

50.original: You do the scouting, and I'll do the sewing─it's as simple as that, dahling. Just let me know when you're ready to start the show!

51.original: Well? Ready to embark on your maiden voyage as designer extraordinaire, dahling? We'll need a model, but did you have anyone in mind?

52.original: Who will you ask to be your model?

58.original: A fabulous choice, dahling! Well, let's not waste time: call them over so we can commence our styling session!

59.original: Now, I presume you've some reason for summoning me here?

60.original: ...You want me to <hex:021A020203>what<hex:021A020103>!? I had heard today's festivities would include heretofore unseen entertainment, but I certainly didn't imagine I would be providing it.

61.original: While I'm no stranger to public performances, gladiator tournaments are a vastly different beast than...whatever this gorgeous affair is.

62.original: I can't say I see myself as fit for the role, but if you insist, I have little choice but to acquiesce.

63.original: So <hex:021A020203>this<hex:021A020103> is our lucky model-to-be! You certainly know how to pick them, dahling. Now, what did you have in mind as far as a concept is concerned?

67.original: Say no more! I'll go prepare an ensemble for our model-to-be. <hex:021A020203>You<hex:021A020103> just sit tight and get ready to awe your audience!

68.original: ...Oh, splendid! That fits like a glove. Now, go out there and knock them dead, dahling!

69.original: Thank you kindly for your participation. And now, let us hear our judge's evaluation!

70.original: Such passion... Why, I could feel your spirit bursting through the seams and spilling forth onto the stage!

71.original: There has never been a foe too ferocious for the gladiators' guildmaster─and today, you've proven there is likewise no foe too fashionable. You've slain the competition!

72.original: 'Twas quite a treat to see you reveal a softer side on this stage. Why, it simply set my heart aflutter!

73.original: There is great beauty in the fluidity of your fighting, and your ensemble today serves to highlight that elegance. Splendidly done!

74.original: 'Tis strange: a simple walk across the stage never rattled my nerves until today. Perhaps it's because I'm so accustomed to having an opponent to train my eyes upon. I felt rather aimless without someone to watch.

75.original: That said, it <hex:021A020203>was<hex:021A020103> rather refreshing to don a different set of clothes for once. Can't say I'll do it again any time soon, but I shall cherish this experience all the same.

76.original: Perhaps I'll put a touch more care into choosing what I wear henceforth─and should I require any assistance to that end, I hope I can count on you both.

77.original: If you're in need of ore, I'd be happy to put in a request with the guild on your behalf...

78.original: ...Did I mishear you, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>? You wish to make a <hex:021A020203>model<hex:021A020103> of me!?

79.original: Oh, my... Although I had planned on taking part in today's festivities, this certainly isn't what I had in mind.

80.original: But you've piqued my curiosity. I've always been enamored of life on the stage, after all. Very well─I shall be your muse!

84.original: I am by no means a miner, but were you and I to cross paths in a quarry somewhere, not even the brightest gleaming gem could draw my eye away from your beauty!

85.original: Those shimmering stones should consider themselves lucky to be unearthed by a living, breathing treasure such as you.

86.original: Your ensemble evokes an elegance that is often sought yet rarely found─a diamond hidden amongst the dust and darkness. You are a treasure to behold!

87.original: Why, this must be how you miners feel when you uncover a precious stone. And to think that I would figuratively strike it rich on my first attempt!

88.original: A miner like myself isn't often thrust into the spotlight─especially given how much time I spend underground─and I think I might prefer to keep it that way.

89.original: But I must say the ensemble you picked out was quite charming! So charming, in fact, that I'm inclined to wear it home.

90.original: This was quite the unforgettable experience, if unexpected. Thank you both again for the invitation!

91.original: Well? If you've got business with me, then be quick about it: I don't want to miss the Songbirds!

92.original: ...What's that, <hex:02080EE905FF056C617373FF04736F6E03>? You want <hex:021A020203>me<hex:021A020103> to get up on that stage!?

93.original: Hah hah hah! It seems the Holyfist's good looks aren't lost on you. Well, if you think I'm a knockout now, you should've seen me in my youth!

94.original: Say, if my turn as a model goes well, I might even enjoy some renewed popularity with the ladies─just like in the olden days. Well? No time to waste. Let's hop to it!

98.original: Th-This is...a most novel ensemble. It provides a playful youthfulness that belies your years.

99.original: And while I cannot imagine enrobing myself with those raiments, I must say the power pouring forth from within you pulls that outfit together in a way others would envy.

100.original: You must forgive me for underestimating you, but I certainly didn't expect you to take such a fashion-forward approach to your ensemble...

101.original: I must say, I'm quite impressed. Why, you may even have a future as a model for the <hex:021A020203>Mythril Eye<hex:021A020103>! I daresay men your age could take a few pointers from your stylish sensibilities.

102.original: What a thrill! Did you see the way those lasses watched me? Why, their lustful gaze was so hot it nearly burned clean through my costume!

103.original: Who would've thought a simple change of clothes was all it'd take to bring this old coot back to his lady-killing heyday?

104.original: At this rate, I might as well start calling myself “Handsomefist” instead! Hah hah hah!

105.original: If you're looking to embark on an expedition, you'd best run it by the chief first...

106.original: <gasp> Y-You want me to <hex:021A020203>model<hex:021A020103> for you? No...I couldn't!

107.original: Although...if everything goes well, and word gets around to <hex:021A020203>her<hex:021A020103>...

108.original: V-Very well! I've made up my mind: I'll do it! Dress me as you see fit!

110.original: Ditch the goggles, show the face!

111.original: Dress in brown, show some style!

112.original: Oh, I could get lost in those big, round eyes... Even a single glance makes my heart skip a beat! You Lalafell boys are simply adorable.

113.original: And your ensemble today only serves to highlight your inherent cuteness. Why, I can barely restrain myself from leaping out of my seat and squeezing you right now!

114.original: This all-brown ensemble of yours is so chic! If a stylish mechanist like you tried to sell me the most expensive magitek device you own, I'd pay top gil for it without question.

115.original: While I recognize that folk in your line of work are often forced into wearing the same uniform day in and day out, I encourage you to experiment a little when you're off the clock!

116.original: Th-That was unbelievably terrifying! The sound of my heartbeat was thundering in my ears the entire time!

117.original: Would I could have only heard the crowd cheering for me... But seeing their smiling faces was exhilarating in its own right!

118.original: ...Although I think this proves I'm better suited to staying behind the scenes. I-If you require another model, might I suggest Biggs?

119.original: Well, then. Fancy a spot of strength training, adventurer?

121.original: I say, it certainly isn't in my nature to get all dressed up─or very dressed at all! But a new experience could be elucidating... Very well─I'll do it!

125.original: Your calm demeanor belies a formidable passion that only a man of your years can exude─a fine wine that I would give anything to imbibe.

126.original: And although those sunglasses may cover your eyes, I can feel your gaze piercing straight through my heart. Everything about your ensemble is fabulous!

127.original: M-My word... Muscles upon muscles, all chiseled to perfection...

128.original: You have exhibited great courage in sporting such an austere ensemble─and for that, I must both commend and thank you. I shall not forget your fantastic physique as long as I live!

129.original: Ohohoho! What did you think, adventurer? Certainly not an ensemble I would've chosen for myself.

130.original: But your unique sensibilities have provided me with just the inspiration I needed. Yes, I can feel the creative juices surging through my entire body!

131.original: I'd best set to work on my next piece before this spark fades away. Farewell!

132.original: Well done, dahling! Your model seemed to have a splendid time─and I quite enjoyed providing couture counsel as well.

133.original: If you stumble upon another model-in-the-making, just let me know. I'd be more than happy to offer additional styling assistance!
